summary: Side-effect-free joint-entry counter. Scans a 64-byte-strided entry array starting at this+0x16CC, counting consecutive entries whose first byte is non-zero, until an empty entry or a cap of seven entries is reached, and returns the count (v1 - 44, in the range 0..7). Called by sub_475A90 (0x00475A90).

operations.description: Seed the counter v1 = 44 and the element pointer v2 = this + 5836 (this + 0x16CC, first joint entry) before entering the scan.
do-while scan of the 64-byte-strided entry array starting at this+0x16CC, iterating until the counter exceeds 50 (at most seven entries).
Break out of the scan as soon as an entry whose first byte is zero is found (*v2 == 0), treating it as the end of the active entries.
Advance the scan by incrementing the counter (++v1) and stepping the pointer to the next entry (v2 += 64).
Return v1 - 44, the number of consecutive non-zero entries counted (0..7).
Called by sub_475A90 (0x00475A90) to obtain the count of active joint entries.
